candidates.name: paraphrase_aware_retrieval
candidates.hypothesis: Because benchmark questions deliberately paraphrase source text, instructing the agent in context_mgmt to treat question clues as paraphrases and avoid wrapping descriptive clauses in quotation marks (reserving quotes only for proper nouns) will eliminate zero-hit search loops and improve pass rate.
candidates.changes: Updated context_mgmt/default.py _DEFAULT_EXTRA_SYSTEM with explicit guidance on paraphrase awareness and unquoted keyword formulation.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Faster document discovery, reducing turns on difficult retrieval tasks and increasing pass rate from 46.7% to >=53.3%.
